releases.notes:
Hontun now solves map captchas for you, runs on Minecraft 26.3 as well as 26.2, and can tell you which anticheat a server is running. ### ✨ Changes - **Captcha solver.** When a server shows a map captcha (Sonar, LimboFilter and similar), Hontun reads the code off the map and types it for you. It runs a small built-in model, so there is nothing to download, and when it is not sure it leaves the code to you instead of guessing. New `Captcha Solver` module.

- **Minecraft 26.3 support.** There is now a separate build for 26.3 next to the 26.2 one. Pick the jar for your version on the download page; the addon works the same on both. - **Anticheat Detect, and `.server anticheat`.** A new passive module works out which anticheat a server runs, from its plugins, commands, plugin channels, the first ping IDs after you join and the way it pulls you back after a failed move. `.server anticheat` prints what it found and how sure it is, and it never sends anything to the server.

- **`.server software` knows a lot more, and knows it sooner.** It now recognises the VeloFlame proxy, UniverseSpigot, ShreddedPaper, Spigot against CraftBukkit, Forge, NeoForge and their hybrids, and more from-scratch servers (Pumpkin, Sonar, LimboAPI, SteelMC, FerrumC, QuasarMC). Most of it is worked out the moment you join instead of after watching the server for a while.

- **Redesigned cursors.** The theme cursors are drawn in a cleaner, more modern style. The clickable cursor is now a crisp pointer with a small click mark, not a cartoon hand.

- **Readable light mode.** The ClickGUI in light mode no longer uses colours so dark they are hard to make out. Accents, text and buttons now keep enough contrast against light backgrounds in every theme.

- **Anti-Exploit got much broader.** Many more kinds of malformed or oversized server data are now handled safely instead of crashing, freezing or disconnecting you: item components and bundles, tooltips and names, chat and other text, advancements, scoreboards, map markers, entity data, mount chains, recipe displays, command trees and registry floods. Items always stay visible and usable, and oversized text is shortened for display instead of dropped. It stays under `illegal-items`, `broken-packets` and `rate-limit`.
New settings `Captcha Solver` module: - `mode`: `Send` or `Suggest` (default `Send`). Send types the code for you when it is sure enough; Suggest only shows the guess. - `min-confidence`: 0 to 1 (default 0.8). How sure the model must be before it sends on its own. - `solve-key`: unbound by default. Solve the current map on demand, ignoring the confidence gate. `Anticheat Detect` module: - `auto-enable`: on by default. - `debug`: off by default.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/HonzasikCZ/Meteor-Addon-Hontun/compare/1.0.6...1.0.7

releases.notes:
Screens now fade into each other, a blocky night landscape can sit behind your menus, each theme brings its own mouse cursors and crosshair, and Anti-Exploit keeps broken packets and illegal items from kicking or crashing you. ### ✨ Changes - **Screens fade into each other** instead of snapping. Menus, Hontun screens and the ClickGUI crossfade from the previous screen, with a slight zoom when you move between menus outside a world.

- **Blocky Horizon menu scene.** Set `menu-scene` to `BlockyHorizon` for a blocky night landscape with a moon, stars, clouds and fireflies behind the title screen and every menu shown without a world. It is tinted by `palette-color` on your `menu-background`, and SmogClient keeps it black and white.

- **Cursors and a crosshair for each theme.** HVanilla, HModern1, HModern2 and SmogClient draw all eight mouse cursors and the in-game crosshair in their own style, and they update the moment you change `ui-mode`, `palette-color` or the GUI scale.

- **The join card shows the resource pack.** When a server sends one while you join, it appears as a step under Join or World with its download progress, then whether it was applied, declined or failed.

- **Anti-Exploit keeps you in the game.** Broken item, chat and other packets your client cannot read are now skipped instead of disconnecting you with Network Protocol Error (`broken-packets`). Illegal items like overstacked gear no longer flood your log, or crash your game when they sit in a bundle (`illegal-items`). - **Chinese, Japanese and Korean text** in the ClickGUI no longer shows up as blank space, for example in translated module names. Any other letters the Hontun font does not have are drawn with Minecraft's font too, and the text wraps properly now. (X-C-0/catppuccin-addon#24)

- Switching ClickGUI tabs keeps the top bar in place, only the content fades. - Lexend Deca is now bundled and shows up in Meteor's font list (Config tab, Font). It is only an option, nothing switches to it by default. - The selected button in the version picker (Auto Detect or Use global version) now stands out in every theme, and its marker matches your theme. - While you drag a ClickGUI window in a world, the game behind it dims so the snap grid is easier to see. - The Hontun logo on the title screen now uses your `palette-color` instead of a lighter shade of it. - Added RealAC to the plugin scanner. - Fixed collapsed ClickGUI windows in the lower half of the screen jumping up and overlapping others. Expanding one moves it up to fit, and collapsing puts it back where you left it. (X-C-0/catppuccin-addon#29) - Fixed being disconnected when a server sends an item with a tag your client does not know, or updates a boss bar that does not exist. Anti-Exploit now ignores both (`broken-packets`). ...

releases.notes:
**Changes:**

*   `Every theme now has its own ClickGUI. It switches when you change ui-mode, and click-gui lets you pick any of the five`
*   `Light mode is easier to read in every ClickGUI`
*   `All ClickGUIs share the same window layout`
*   `Fixed lag when moving ClickGUI windows, and the snap grid is back to its old size`
*   `Fixed the dark text in the lag notifier, it now follows its own shadow and scale settings`
*   `New connecting and world loading screen for every theme`
*   `Themed the Add Server and Direct Connection text boxes and the slot hover highlight`
*   `.server software no longer sends anything and detects more right at join, including CraftBukkit, Spigot, UniverseSpigot, PicoLimbo, QuasarMC, LOOHP Limbo, NanoLimbo and Minestom`
*   `Channel Sender can now send automatically every few ticks`
*   `Added TotemGuard to the plugin scanner`
*   `Fixed dragged servers sliding sideways`

releases.notes:
**Changes:**

*   `Added a light mode for the ClickGUI, tick light-mode in the GUI tab right under ui-mode. Menus, chat, inventories and the HUD stay dark`
*   `Added .server software, it guesses what the server runs (Paper, Purpur, Folia, Spigot, Vanilla, Fabric...) and if there is a Velocity or BungeeCord proxy in front, and tells you how sure it is`
*   `Added .server software full, it also runs /version and one made-up command to get the exact fork. The replies are hidden from your chat but both commands show up in the server log`
*   `Added .server software passive, it only uses what your client already got and sends nothing`
*   `.server now shows the detected server software`
*   `Inventories, chests, furnaces, hoppers, shulkers, dispensers and the crafting table are now themed in every mode except Vanilla`
*   `Themed the sliders (FOV, volume and so on)`
*   `Themed the recipe book button`
*   `Added an animated background for SmogClient`
*   `Smoother dots and crosses in SmogClient accounts, versions and proxies`
*   `Slimmer scrollbar and better looking dragging in the SmogClient server list`
*   `Greyed out buttons and sliders in SmogClient now use the SF font too`
*   `Channel Sender can now send hex or a number, not just text`
*   `Channel Sender can now send up to 20000 packets`
*   `Fixed the version list in HVanilla still using the vanilla button texture`
*   `Fixed modules-help-text not doing anything`
*   `Fixed the color picker icon being invisible on bright colors`
